name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a junior silver-gold-copper explorer focused on the Diablillos project in Salta province, northwestern Argentina. The company is in the advanced exploration stage with an active multi-phase drill program targeting high-grade silver-gold mineralization at the flagship Diablillos property. In 2026 the company expanded its land package with the adjacent Condoryacu and Maria Amalia acquisitions.
